propositions: Bounded completion recovery refused any context over 24,000 chars, so correct merged work could not reach closed except via --force-close.
The context cap is raised to 100,000 chars with no elision, covering the two blocked tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) with headroom.
A step-budget exhaustion failure falsely told the operator to install the agents extra because the remedy was selected by exception type instead of by cause; it is now selected by cause.
The bounds were mutually incoherent because _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS (32,000) exceeded _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS (24,000); an invariant test pins the cap at or above the criteria budget.
Compaction of over-cap context was implemented then withdrawn because on epic closes it silently deleted whole child tickets and their unmet criteria, producing a signed false PASS.
An over-cap payload must still fail fast with zero billable recovery calls, and a genuine unavailability must still receive the install-the-extra guidance.
